title: Eugenia M Possible NDE 7168
content: For a number of years I had been telling my doctor that I was always sad and depressed. Crying for no reason and then switching over to uncontrollable rage. I was ignored by her! Both of my parents and my husband had passed within a 3-year period of each other, so I was dealing with enormous loss. One day a 'voice' in my head, whom I now call 'Dark Man' or 'DM' for short, was telling me to just stop the pain for good. I did what he said, putting various drugs into a bowl and swallowing them! I washed them down with liquor. When I was found hours later, I was near dead and the Emergency Medical Technicians started emergency support. Later, while in the hospital, I remember a floating feeling and a very warm soft light. I was in a beautiful field full of wild flowers. The light was coming over the horizon, like a morning dawn! I was completely at peace, feeling only surrounding warmth, light and total love. As I floated toward the light, I was very eager to reach it but then a shadowy form was off to my left. I felt a touch on my left shoulder and a voice saying 'it's not your time. You have to go back!' I didn't want to go back; I was happy where I was! The voice said 'No, you have to go back'. The next thing I remember was waking up in the hospital, feeling all muffled and groggy, saying I had to use the rest room! Much later, the Doctors moved me over to another part of the hospital: the psych ward. I thought I had been in the hospital for a week, I later found out that I was there for almost a month! To this day, I can remember every detail of the field of flowers, the beautiful light and the form who was there!

arrival.other_being_detail: A shadowy form off to the left; a touch on the left shoulder; a voice said, 'it's not your time. You have to go back!'

environment.environment_other_detail: A beautiful field full of wild flowers; warm soft light coming over the horizon like a morning dawn.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Intentional overdose with various drugs and liquor after hearing an internal 'voice' urging her to stop the pain.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Floating feeling; beautiful field of wild flowers; shadowy form; touch on left shoulder; instructed to return; woke up in hospital groggy and muffled.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel or explicit OBE described; experience begins with floating feeling and immediate arrival in a field with light, then a being/voice instructs return, followed by waking in hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Prior to the overdose, she reports an internal 'voice' she later calls 'Dark Man' (DM) urging her to stop the pain for good. During the experience, she also notices a shadowy form to her left before being told to return.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “it's not your time. You have to go back!” / “No, you have to go back”.
